E2_MULTIDATASET_LEAKAGE.key_finding: Temporal leakage severity depends on dataset characteristics. SWaT: +0.26, TEP: +0.03

SWaT.interpretation: Massive leakage. Under temporal split, LSTM-AE is barely above random. Z-score is competitive.

TEP.interpretation: Minimal leakage. High anomaly density (67%) and long fault segments minimize window overlap effects. Z-score BEATS LSTM-AE!
